# Context Pack: `sprint-qa-investigation` — QA adversarial investigation Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen). Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5. Domain: governed-sprint-delivery. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments. ## 1. Purpose Read-only, bounded adversarial QA over one sprint's changed paths. The surface decomposes execute-evidence changed paths into a byte-stable shard map, runs fenced read-only LLM "investigators" per shard under hard budgets (turns, retries, timeouts, output bytes), accepts only strictly decoded theory drafts with closed outcome enums, deterministically synthesizes outcomes/dedup/contradictions/follow-ups, and persists everything in a private `verification/` tree whose flow-state pointer is always written last. QA annotates; it never changes the Conformance Review verdict, promotes issues, or repairs code (cli-reference.md:346-361; ARCHITECTURE.md verification-boundary section). ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow ### 2.1 CLI (`sprint

qa`, sprint_commands.go:369-466) `parseSprintQAArgs` (sprint_commands.go:588) admits actions run(default)|map(`--dry-run`)|status|resume|cancel|recover plus `--shard `, `--run ` (cancel-only), `--json`. Dispatch: - **map**: `Service.QAMap` — pure; no runtime, no durable acceptance, no state write. - **status**: `QAStatus` — read-only projection of the pointer and its referenced records. - **recover**: `RecoverQA(ctx)` under the full mutation lease. - **cancel**: builds `dashboardUseCases` and calls `CancelQA` — run-control only; no sprint mutation lease is taken. - **run/resume**: `beginDurableCLICommand(OperationQAStart/QAResume)` (accept-before-execute), `durable.QAWriterToken()` mints token+fence from the accepted operation context (durable_operations.go:64-69,140-156), then `sprintRuntimeService(...).WithQAWriterFence(fence).RunQA(durable.Context(), …)`. Afterwards `QAStatus` is re-read for the result projection; `finishDurableCLICommand` proposes the run terminal. All actions append the review-status projection via `withQAConformanceReview` (sprint_usecases.go:747-758, `WithoutStatusWrites`) and render through `renderSprintQA`/JSON envelope with `mapQACommandError` exit mapping (sprint_commands.go:662-679: canceled/deadline→8, runtime/persistence→6, other QA categories→5). ### 2.2 TUI/web runtime path `sharedOperationRunner` case OperationQAStart/QAResume (operation_runner.go:114-130): `qaOwnershipFromContext(ctx)` extracts the ownership value stored by `AcceptOperation` (durable_operations.go:130-131); fence closure heartbeats the outer run-control lease on every check via `repository.Heartbeat` under `context.WithoutCancel`+30s (durable_operations.go:146-154). Web/TUI read projections: `dashboardUseCases.QAStatus/QAShard/QATheory/QASynthesis` (sprint_usecases.go:626-693). Web/TUI cancel: `CancelQA` validates run ownership (project/sprint/kind ∈ {qa-start,qa-resume}) before `runs.CancelRun(…, "read-only QA cancellation requested")` (sprint_usecases.go:716-737). Operation-request admission restricts QA kinds to project/sprint/shard-only fields (`validateQAOperationRequest`, operations.go:594-611) and lists prerequisites "complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "approved read-only target" (operations.go:597). ### 2.3 QAMap → BuildQAMap (qa_map.go:43-137, 139-277) Pure map construction: settings validation → `PrepareReview(ReviewRequest{})` must return zero findings → `LoadFlowState` gate: `flow.Review` non-nil, non-stale, fingerprint set, Status ∈ {Completed, Blocked} (terminal) → changed paths = `normalizeQAStrings(manifest.ChangedPaths)`, rejecting empty or single "(…)" placeholders ("execute evidence does not enumerate changed paths") → `targetIdentity(manifest.Target)` as implementation fingerprint → input refs from manifest input hashes (missing ⇒ stale) plus review.md digest when recorded → governed/policy/check-catalog fingerprints are sha256 over canonical JSON (fingerprintQAValue) → adjacent-context pairing `.go`↔`_test.go` by os.Stat → expectation refs from coverage IDs else `["governed-plan"]` → git identity (HEAD, hashed cached diff, hashed status --short) → approved-check catalog. `BuildQAMap` groups paths by `qaBehaviorGroup` (extension allowlist .go/.md/.html/.js/.css/.yml/.yaml/.json/.sh/.sql; keys internal/, cmd/, root/, or top dir), sorts groups, chunks per ChangedPathsPerShard, pre-blocks unclassified paths (Phase blocked + blocker, no silent omission), adds one boundary shard when >1 primary (overlap = first changed path of each primary, capped at ContextPathsPerShard), enforces PrimaryShards/TotalShards/PendingEntries budgets, sorts shards by content-derived ID, and enforces exactly-one-primary-owner per changed path in `ValidateQAMap`. `NormalizedQAMapBytes` (MarshalIndent+\n) is the byte-stable form. ### 2.4 RunQA (qa.go:237-360) Ordering: require runtime + valid token + valid settings → wrap progress with `boundedQAProgress` (RecentProgress cap, mutex) → `acquireMutationContext` (in-process sync.Map + pidfile lease held for the whole run) → writer-fence fallback comparator if no real fence installed (qa.go:258-267) → store with fence → `PruneAttempts("")` retention sweep → `VerificationBytes()` ≤ StateBytes else budget-exhausted → `QAMap` rebuild → second `PrepareReview` (findings ⇒ StaleInput) → `LoadFlowState` → `prepareQAAttempt`: - **Resume** (req.Resume ∧ prior.CurrentAttemptID == current SemanticAttemptID ∧ prior.Map != nil): retained Completed/Blocked shards reloaded from disk; run correlation reset to the NEW token (Claimed), phase queued, blocker/cancellation cleared, published. - Otherwise fresh: phase mapped, Map+Shards+State published together, state reloaded, prune protecting the current attempt. A resume whose prior attempt ID mismatches silently falls through to this fresh path. Then phase running published (state only) → `runQAShardBatch` #1 → on error `terminalQAState`+publish+return; else synthesizing publish → pure `SynthesizeQA(map, shards)` → if follow-up shards proposed: append them (TotalShards grows), run batch #2, re-synthesize → `hydrateQASynthesisFollowUps` requires every follow-up to have reached retained terminal Completed/Blocked → final publish (all Shards + Synthesis + completed State) → reload state → emit complete. ### 2.5 Shard execution (qa.go:428-666) Batch skips already-terminal shards unless FocusShard selects one (unknown/terminal focus ⇒ InvalidState). Workers = min(ConcurrentInvestigators, pending); jobs/results channels; a publication failure closes `abortResults` and cancels the batch context while draining results; per-result shard phase mapping: Canceled→cancelled, DeadlineExceeded→interrupted, other errors→blocked (+blocker); state republished after EACH terminal shard. `runOneQAShardSafely` recovers panics into RuntimeUnavailable blockers. `runOneQAShard`: `validateCurrentQAMap` (installed qaMapFence, else full deterministic map rebuild comparing map IDs) → investigator request built from `RenderQAInvestigatorPrompt` (packet JSON embedded; PromptBytes cap) with Sandbox=read_only, Permissions=restricted, RequireCaps=[permissions], tool policy default deny {read,list,search,glob allow}, PathRules allow-listing contained changed+context paths, Timeout=ShardTimeout, metadata operation/task/operational_attempt → retry loop ≤ RuntimeRetries+1: targetIdentity before-run must equal map fingerprint (else StaleInput); StartRun; identity after-run drift ⇒ PermissionDenied; map revalidated (governed-input drift ⇒ StaleInput); result.Permissions must be restricted/deny/0-unsupported else PermissionDenied fail-closed; success path enforces Turns ≤ IterationsPerAttempt else BudgetExhausted; failure classification (`classifyQARuntimeFailure`): canceled/deadline return immediately; result.Error.Category ∈ {validation,invalid_input,permission_denied,configuration,unsupported} non-retryable; unknown categories retryable until the bound. Then `decodeQAInvestigatorOutput`: TerminalOutput or last event payload["content"], size ∈ (0, ShardOutputBytes], strict single JSON object, DisallowUnknownFields, schema_version==1 → output-count budgets vs TheoriesPerShard/ContextExpansions/CommandsPerAttempt → context requests: self-approval (Approved=true) rejected PermissionDenied, path count ≤ PathsPerExpansion, each path validateQA... (line truncated to 2000 chars) ### 2.6 Approved-check policy (qa_prompt.go:59-134, 243-285) Catalog today is a single descriptor `go-format-diff` (gofmt -d ) when any changed path ends .go; cwd pinned to target root; timeout/output limits from budgets. `validateQACheckDescriptor` bans interpreters/shells/git (lowercased basename blocklist), shell/redirection metacharacters in args, `-w`/`--write*` flags, arg paths that are absolute or escape the target, and env names outside {LANG, LC_ALL, TZ}. Descriptor fingerprint covers all fields except the fingerprint itself. ### 2.7 Synthesis (qa_synthesis.go) Pure over validated inputs; rejects shards from another semantic attempt. Sort-normalizes shards/theories/challenges; challenge count ≤ FollowUpShards, each must reference known theory IDs and carry the map ID. Equivalence key = lower(join(claim, verification_surface, sorted expectation refs)) drives dedup (first ID retains the rest) and contradiction detection (confirmed ∧ refuted in one group). Interactions pair cross-shard theories or pairs sharing risk tags. Follow-up candidates = cross_shard/inconclusive theories capped at FollowUpShards; each becomes a follow_up shard with parent-theory link and deterministic ID. Blockers collected and sorted; NextAction ladder follow-ups > blockers > inspect. `ValidateQASynthesis` re-checks identities, budgets, references. ### 2.8 Status/recover (qa.go:55-205) `QAStatus` loads the pointer then referenced records strictly; missing state.json yields a Missing-phase snapshot (nil error); synthesis loads under map budgets (or Maximum); planned + follow-up shards merged sorted; never writes. `RecoverQA` holds the mutation lease; recomputes the expected flow summary from current state.json bytes digest; queued/running/synthesizing ⇒ Interrupted (Conflict blocker "prior process stopped…"); mapped ⇒ Interrupted with resume hint; ANY current-map error or semantic-attempt mismatch ⇒ Stale + not-current; unchanged states return untouched; changes go through `SaveRecoveredState` (state write + flow pointer only) then optional prune. `SaveRecoveredState` refuses active phases (qa_state.go:429-434). Boot-time reconcile additionally converts queued/running/synthesizing to Interrupted via SaveRecoveredState (locks.go:76-97). ## 3. Inputs / outputs Inputs: effective config (model/variant/budgets/sources provenance; lower-only vs hard maxima, app/sprint_commands.go:713-787, platform/config/qa.go), review manifest (changed paths, governed-input hashes, coverage IDs, resolved absolute Target), flow-state Review record, execute evidence indirectly via manifest, target worktree contents (git commands + file walk in `targetIdentity`, verify.go:349-435), wall clock (`s.now()`), os environment for allowlisted check env names. Investigator LLM output (TerminalOutput/events) and check stdout/stderr enter as untrusted data. Outputs: private files under `projects/

/sprints//verification/` (state.json, attempts//{map.json,shards/.json,synthesis.json}), QAFlowSummary pointer in flow-state.json written last, pruned attempt dirs, durable outer run rows + events (via spine), progress callbacks (bounded), CLI text/JSON projections, exit-classified errors (`QAError{Category,Operation,Detail,Recovery}` with recovery guidance table, qa_types.go:772-841). ## 4. Authoritative state - `verification/state.json` — QAState (phase, freshness quadruple, current attempt ID, map/synthesis artifact refs with sha256 digests, shard counters, outcome counts, blocker, cancellation, run correlation, next action). - `attempts//` — map.json (immutable bytes: rewrite with different bytes ⇒ Conflict), shards/, synthesis.json. - Flow pointer `flow-state.json` field `qa` — bounded projection incl. StatePath + StateDigest of the exact state.json bytes; preserved across unrelated saves (SaveFlowState nil-backfill) and status refreshes (service.go:268); validated by `validateQAFlowSummary` (state.go:369-384: contained `.../verification/state.json`, 64-hex digest, valid optional attempt ID). Rides into the product-state DB mirror as part of the FlowState header when DB-authoritative; the QA tree itself has no DB representation. - Durable run rows (.ultraplan/run-control.db) own liveness/cancellation for qa-start/qa-resume operations; inner runtime runs correlate via ParentRun (spine seam). - Retention: newest RetainedAttempts (≤8) attempt dirs by modtime; protected argument pins the current attempt; every directory entry must be a validly named attempt dir or pruning fails hard (qa_state.go:82-136). - Layout grammar: IDs are `qa-v1--<24 hex>` derived from scope|kind|project|sprint|parent|canonical-identity sha256 (qa_types.go:483-507); paths resolve through `resolveSprintContained` plus a rel-to-sprint prefix check and per-component Lstat symlink rejection (qa_state.go:183-211). ## 5. Invariants (as implemented) - Closed enums everywhere: 11 phase statuses, 7 theory outcomes, 8 error categories (pinned by test). - Deterministic identity: identical semantic inputs reproduce attempt/map/shard/theory/challenge/synthesis IDs byte-for-byte; any fingerprint or changed-path change yields new IDs. - Byte-stable maps and syntheses (MarshalIndent canonical ordering; sort-before-emit everywhere). - Budgets are lower-only: workspace/env may reduce, never exceed, shipped maxima; both config loader and `validateQABudgets` enforce positivity and maxima. - Publication order: writer-fence check first (fail-closed when no fence configured in the store, qa_state.go:453-464), then map (immutable) → shards → synthesis → state LAST → flow pointer last-of-all via SaveFlowState; every record temp+fsync+rename with 0700 dirs (chmod walk up to `verification`) and 0600 files; load requires regular file with perm exactly 0600, ≤128 MiB, schema_version==1 (0 ⇒ InvalidState, other ≠1 ⇒ UnknownSchema), DisallowUnknownFields, single JSON value; referenced artifacts re-hashed against recorded digests on load. - Read-only enforcement is verified, not assumed: post-run permission summary must be restricted/default-deny/zero-unsupported; self-approved context expansions rejected; check requests must reference catalog-owned descriptors by ID+fingerprint; target identity captured before/after every investigator attempt and approved check. - Exactly-one primary owner per changed path; boundary/follow-up shards never own primary coverage. - Recovery can only publish non-active phases and only touches state.json + flow pointer. - Progress emission is capped (RecentProgress) and mutex-guarded. ## 6. Trust boundaries - **Investigator structured output** (LLM-controlled): strict decode, size caps, closed enums, mandatory falsifiability fields, product-assigned IDs/fingerprints/timestamps; outcome text never mutates review verdicts, issues, or code. - **Check execution**: catalog is recomputed server-side each run; descriptors cannot name interpreters, shells, git, write modes, escaping paths, or arbitrary env; cwd pinned to the target; post-run drift detection; child output re-enters only as digests/summaries. - **Changed paths** derive from execute evidence via the review manifest and pass `validateQAPath` (no absolute/`..`/NUL/CR/LF) before becoming prompt content, path rules, or gofmt args. - **flow-state Review record** is trusted gate input for mapping (terminal + non-stale + fingerprinted); mitigations live upstream in review freshness/digest machinery, not here. - **Writer tokens**: minted only inside the durable acceptance boundary from `runcontrol.Fence{RunID, AttemptID, FencingGeneration}`; compared field-for-field on every Publish; each successful check heartbeats the outer lease (WithoutCancel+30s), so state writes are coupled to lease liveness; ErrStaleFence surfaces as Conflict "writer token is stale". - **Private storage**: 0700/0600, symlink rejection on every path component and during byte measurement; digest-pinned internal references defeat tampered record swapping. - **Presentation**: progress messages pass config.RedactValue at CLI rendering (sprint_commands.go:440); projections use displaySafe. ## 7. External effects & lifecycle semantics Effects: writes confined to the verification tree + flow-state QA pointer (+DB mirror via SaveFlowState when authoritative); spawns OpenCode investigators (isolated per-owner SQLite stores under the runtime surface) and short-lived gofmt subprocesses; appends run-control events through the spine; prunes old attempt dirs (RemoveAll). Crash/restart: dead owners leave queued/running/synthesizing residue; `ReconcileInterruptedMutation` (boot) or `RecoverQA` converts it to explicit Interrupted evidence; resume always creates a NEW durable owner and never adopts prior sessions/runtimes; retained terminal shards are reused only while the semantic attempt ID still matches the freshly computed map. Exit classes: usage 2 / config 3 / validation·stale·policy 5 / runtime·persistence 6 / canceled·deadline 8 (docs/cli-reference.md:363). ## 8. Immediate surface dependencies - **sprint-conformance-review**: PrepareReview manifest/findings gate mapping twice (directly and inside QAMap); flow.Review terminality gate; review.md digest appended to input refs; `withQAConformanceReview` decorates every QA result (seam `qa-review-freshness`: model/policy changes alter the policy fingerprint and make retained attempts stale; QA annotates, never alters verdicts). - **sprint-execute-resume**: changed paths and execute completeness arrive via PrepareReview findings/manifest; "(…)"-style placeholder paths rejected. - **durable-operation-spine**: accept-before-execute, writer-token mint + heartbeat fence (seam `qa-writer-fence-handoff`: sprint never imports runcontrol; token shape is the entire contract), cancellation routing, OperationKind strings qa-start/qa-resume persisted in run rows. - **process-execution**: DirectRunner argv execution for approved checks (env allowlist, output caps, cleanup grace, truncation reporting). - **opencode-agent-runtime**: Runtime.StartRun request/result contract (Sandbox/Permissions/Policy enforcement summaries, TerminalOutput/Events, Usage, EstimatedCost, Error.Category). - **sprint-flow-state**: LoadFlowState gate; SaveFlowState pointer publication with nil-QA backfill preservation; mutation lease shared with all other verification stages (held for the entire run duration). - **config-inspection-health**: qa.* admission (defaults/yml/env, lower-only maxima, source provenance recorded into EffectiveSources and the policy fingerprint), RedactValue. - Foundation helpers: resolveSprintContained/ResolveInside containment (workspace), hashFile/hashBytes (smoke.go:706-707). ## 9. missing condition/unknown outcome/bad fingerprint rejected); :107 TestQAErrorPreservesCauseAndRecovery; :119 TestQAStorePublishesPrivateRecordsPointerLastAndLoadsStrictly (0600 files, 0700 verification dir, flow summary populated); :167 strict-load rejections (unknown version→UnknownSchema category, unknown field, trailing JSON, 0644 mode refused); :207 symlinked verification root rejected AND stale-writer Publish creates nothing; :229 atomic rename-failure preserves prior bytes AND immutable map byte-difference conflicts. - qa_map_test.go:9 byte-stability across reordered inputs + exactly-one-owner + single boundary shard; :53 unknown-extension path produces blocked shard without omission; :68 primary/path budget exhaustion; :81 implementation/review/policy fingerprint changes invalidate attempt+map IDs; :109 risk tags and _test.go adjacency carried. - qa_test.go:89 bounded worker concurrency == ConcurrentInvestigators with per-shard persistence; :126 publication failure stops workers (active count drains to 0); :148 panic contained to blocked shard with RuntimeUnavailable blocker; :164 terminal-failure publication + progress bound; :187 permission-fallback rejection, target-drift rejection, governed-map drift (exactly 2 fence evaluations); :225 retry applied once then exhaustion "after 2 attempts"; :248 turn limit + usage/cost retention; :263 mid-flight cancellation persists cancelled shard without retry; :296 strict decoder (unknown field/trailing/version/oversize); :41 determinism under shard reversal with capped follow-ups; :62 challenger records validated, unknown-theory reference rejected, output stable; :88 hydration requires retained terminal follow-up; :149 stale-shard rejection. - qa_prompt_test.go:13 investigator request read-only/default-deny/path-bounded + prompt identity sprint.qa.investigator; Challenger integration: QAChallengerRequest/BuildQAChallenge/SynthesizeQAWithChallenges are implemented and tested, but RunQA always calls SynthesizeQA (challenges=nil). Purpose Read-only, bounded adversarial QA over one sprint's changed paths. qa`, sprint_commands.go:369-466) `parseSprintQAArgs` (sprint_commands.go:588) admits actions run(default)|map(`--dry-run`)|status|resume|cancel|recover plus `--shard `, `--run ` (cancel-only), `--json`. Afterwards `QAStatus` is re-read for the result projection; `finishDurableCLICommand` proposes the run terminal. All actions append the review-status projection via `withQAConformanceReview` (sprint_usecases.go:747-758, `WithoutStatusWrites`) and render through `renderSprintQA`/JSON envelope with `mapQACommandError` exit mapping (sprint_commands.go:662-679: canceled/deadline→8, runtime/persistence→6, other QA categories→5).

func newQAID(kind, project, sprint, parent string, content any) (string, error) {
	if !safeQAName(project) || !safeQAName(sprint) || strings.TrimSpace(kind) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid QA identity scope")
	}
	data, err := canonicalQAJSON(content)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize QA identity: %w", err)
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(bytes.Join([][]byte{[]byte(QAIDScope), []byte(kind), []byte(project), []byte(sprint), []byte(parent), data}, []byte{0}))
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s", QAIDScope, kind, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:12])), nil
}

func canonicalQAJSON(value any) ([]byte, error) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
	encoder.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	if err := encoder.Encode(value); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return bytes.TrimSuffix(buf.Bytes(), []byte("\n")), nil
}

var qaIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^qa-v1-(attempt|map|shard|theory|challenge|synthesis)-[0-9a-f]{24}$`)

func validQAID(value string) bool { return qaIDPattern.MatchString(value) }

func safeQAName(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || len(value) > 128 || strings.Contains(value, "..") {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if !(r == '-' || r == '_' || r == '.' || r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validFingerprint(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != sha256.Size*2 {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
	return err == nil
}

func ValidateQASettings(settings QASettings) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(settings.Runtime.Model) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("qa model is required")
	}
	if err := validateQABudgets(settings.Budgets); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, source := range settings.Sources {
		if strings.TrimSpace(source.Field) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(source.Source) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("QA effective source requires field and source")
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[source.Field]; duplicate {
			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate QA effective source %q", source.Field)
		}
		seen[source.Field] = struct{}{}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateQABudgets(got QABudgets) error {
	max := MaximumQABudgets()
	ints := []struct {
		name     string
		got, max int
	}{
		{"changed_paths", got.ChangedPaths, max.ChangedPaths}, {"primary_shards", got.PrimaryShards, max.PrimaryShards}, {"boundary_shards", got.BoundaryShards, max.BoundaryShards},
		{"follow_up_shards", got.FollowUpShards, max.FollowUpShards}, {"total_shards", got.TotalShards, max.TotalShards}, {"pending_entries", got.PendingEntries, max.PendingEntries},
		{"changed_paths_per_shard", got.ChangedPathsPerShard, max.ChangedPathsPerShard}, {"context_paths_per_shard", got.ContextPathsPerShard, max.ContextPathsPerShard},
		{"context_expansions", got.ContextExpansions, max.ContextExpansions}, {"paths_per_expansion", got.PathsPerExpansion, max.PathsPerExpansion},
		{"behavioral_concerns_per_shard", got.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, max.BehavioralConcernsPerShard}, {"theories_per_shard", got.TheoriesPerShard, max.TheoriesPerShard},
		{"iterations_per_attempt", got.IterationsPerAttempt, max.IterationsPerAttempt}, {"commands_per_attempt", got.CommandsPerAttempt, max.CommandsPerAttempt},
		{"output_repair_attempts", got.OutputRepairAttempts, max.OutputRepairAttempts}, {"concurrent_investigators", got.ConcurrentInvestigators, max.ConcurrentInvestigators},
		{"command_output_bytes", got.CommandOutputBytes, max.CommandOutputBytes}, {"shard_output_bytes", got.ShardOutputBytes, max.ShardOutputBytes},
		{"prompt_bytes", got.PromptBytes, max.PromptBytes}, {"recent_progress", got.RecentProgress, max.RecentProgress},
		{"retained_attempts", got.RetainedAttempts, max.RetainedAttempts}, {"state_bytes", got.StateBytes, max.StateBytes},
		{"tree_files", got.TreeFiles, max.TreeFiles}, {"generated_checks", got.GeneratedChecks, max.GeneratedChecks},
		{"generated_patch_bytes", got.GeneratedPatchBytes, max.GeneratedPatchBytes}, {"evidence_records", got.EvidenceRecords, max.EvidenceRecords},
		{"issues", got.Issues, max.Issues}, {"analyzer_calls", got.AnalyzerCalls, max.AnalyzerCalls}, {"evaluator_calls", got.EvaluatorCalls, max.EvaluatorCalls},
	}
	for _, limit := range ints {
		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
		}
	}
	durations := []struct {
		name     string
		got, max time.Duration
	}{{"command_timeout", got.CommandTimeout, max.CommandTimeout}, {"shard_timeout", got.ShardTimeout, max.ShardTimeout}, {"run_timeout", got.RunTimeout, max.RunTimeout}, {"cleanup_timeout", got.CleanupTimeout, max.CleanupTimeout}}
	for _, limit := range durations {
		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be positive and no greater than %s", limit.name, limit.max)
		}
	}
	for _, limit := range []struct {
		name     string
		got, max int64
	}{{"tree_bytes", got.TreeBytes, max.TreeBytes}, {"file_bytes", got.FileBytes, max.FileBytes}} {
		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
		}
	}
	if got.AnalyzerCalls != 3 || got.EvaluatorCalls != 3 {
		return fmt.Errorf("qa semantic analyzer and evaluator counts must be exactly 3")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQATheory(theory QATheory) error {
	if theory.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(theory.ID) || !validQAID(theory.ShardID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA theory schema or identity")
	}
	required := map[string]string{"claim": theory.Claim, "basis": theory.Basis, "verification_surface": theory.VerificationSurface, "severity_if_confirmed": theory.SeverityIfConfirmed, "confirmation_condition": theory.ConfirmationCondition, "refutation_condition": theory.RefutationCondition, "inconclusive_condition": theory.InconclusiveCondition, "safe_evidence_strategy": theory.SafeEvidenceStrategy, "outcome_reason": theory.OutcomeReason}
	for name, value := range required {
		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("QA theory %s is required", name)
		}
	}
	if len(theory.ExpectationRefs) == 0 || len(theory.AttemptHistory) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA theory expectation references and attempt history are required")
	}
	if !validFingerprint(theory.ImplementationFingerprint) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA theory implementation fingerprint")
	}
	if !containsQATheoryOutcome(theory.Outcome) {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported QA theory outcome %q", theory.Outcome)
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQAMap(m QAMap) error {
	if m.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(m.ID) || !validQAID(m.SemanticAttemptID) || !safeQAName(m.Project) || !safeQAName(m.Sprint) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA map schema or identity")
	}
	for name, value := range map[string]string{"governed input": m.GovernedInputFingerprint, "implementation": m.ImplementationFingerprint, "review": m.ReviewFingerprint, "policy": m.PolicyFingerprint, "check catalog": m.CheckCatalogFingerprint, "target": m.Target.Fingerprint} {
		if !validFingerprint(value) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s fingerprint", name)
		}
	}
	if err := validateQABudgets(m.Budgets); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	owners := map[string]int{}
	ownerIDs := map[string]string{}
	for _, shard := range m.Shards {
		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if shard.Kind == QAShardPrimary {
			for _, path := range shard.ChangedPaths {
				owners[path]++
				ownerIDs[path] = shard.ID
			}
		}
	}
	for _, path := range m.Coverage.ChangedPaths {
		if owners[path] != 1 || m.Coverage.PrimaryOwners[path] != ownerIDs[path] {
			return fmt.Errorf("changed path %q must have exactly one primary owner", path)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQAShard(shard QAShard) error {
	if shard.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(shard.ID) || !validQAID(shard.AttemptID) || strings.TrimSpace(shard.Title) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA shard schema or identity")
	}
	switch shard.Kind {
	case QAShardPrimary:
		if len(shard.ChangedPaths) == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("primary QA shard requires changed paths")
		}
	case QAShardBoundary:
		if len(shard.OverlapPaths) == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(shard.BoundaryReason) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("boundary QA shard requires overlap paths and reason")
		}
	case QAShardFollowUp:
		if len(shard.ParentTheoryIDs) == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("follow-up QA shard requires parent theories")
		}
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported QA shard kind %q", shard.Kind)
	}
	if !containsQAPhase(shard.Phase) || len(shard.BehavioralConcerns) == 0 || len(shard.ExpectationRefs) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard phase, concerns, and expectations are required")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQAState(state QAState) error {
	if state.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion && state.SchemaVersion != QAStateSchemaVersion || !safeQAName(state.Project) || !safeQAName(state.Sprint) || !containsQAPhase(state.Phase) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA state schema, scope, or phase")
	}
	if state.CurrentAttemptID != "" && !validQAID(state.CurrentAttemptID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid current QA attempt ID")
	}
	if state.CompletedShards < 0 || state.TotalShards < 0 || state.CompletedShards > state.TotalShards {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA shard counts")
	}
	if state.EvidenceCount < 0 || state.RejectedCount < 0 || state.IssueCount < 0 || state.RegressionCandidates < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA evidence counts")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(state.NextAction) == "" || state.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA next action and update time are required")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQASynthesis(synthesis QASynthesis, budgets QABudgets) error {
	if synthesis.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(synthesis.ID) || !validQAID(synthesis.AttemptID) || !validQAID(synthesis.MapID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis schema or identity")
	}
	theoryIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(synthesis.TheoryIDs))
	for _, theoryID := range synthesis.TheoryIDs {
		if !validQAID(theoryID) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis theory reference")
		}
		theoryIDs[theoryID] = struct{}{}
	}
	if len(synthesis.FollowUpShards) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds follow-up shard budget")
	}
	if len(synthesis.Challenges) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds challenger record budget")
	}
	for _, challenge := range synthesis.Challenges {
		if err := ValidateQAChallenge(challenge, budgets); err != nil || challenge.MapID != synthesis.MapID {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis challenge")
		}
		for _, theoryID := range challenge.TheoryIDs {
			if _, ok := theoryIDs[theoryID]; !ok {
				return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis challenge references an unknown theory")
			}
		}
	}
	for _, shard := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil || shard.Kind != QAShardFollowUp {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis follow-up shard")
		}
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(synthesis.NextAction) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis next action is required")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQAChallenge(challenge QAChallenge, budgets QABudgets) error {
	if challenge.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(challenge.ID) || !validQAID(challenge.MapID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA challenge schema or identity")
	}
	if len(challenge.TheoryIDs) == 0 || len(challenge.TheoryIDs) > budgets.TheoriesPerShard {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA challenge theory references exceed bounds")
	}
	for _, theoryID := range challenge.TheoryIDs {
		if !validQAID(theoryID) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA challenge theory reference")
		}
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(challenge.Claim) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(challenge.Basis) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(challenge.SafeEvidenceStrategy) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA challenge claim, basis, and safe evidence strategy are required")
	}
	return nil
}

func containsQAPhase(value QAPhaseStatus) bool {
	for _, allowed := range QAPhaseStatuses() {
		if value == allowed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func containsQATheoryOutcome(value QATheoryOutcome) bool {
	for _, allowed := range QATheoryOutcomes() {
		if value == allowed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func normalizeQAStrings(values []string) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, value := range values {
		value = strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(value), "\r\n", "\n")
		if value == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		out = append(out, value)
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

type QAErrorCategory string

const (
	QAErrorUnknownSchema      QAErrorCategory = "unknown_schema"
	QAErrorInvalidState       QAErrorCategory = "invalid_state"
	QAErrorStaleInput         QAErrorCategory = "stale_input"
	QAErrorPermissionDenied   QAErrorCategory = "permission_denied"
	QAErrorBudgetExhausted    QAErrorCategory = "budget_exhausted"
	QAErrorConflict           QAErrorCategory = "conflict"
	QAErrorPersistenceFailure QAErrorCategory = "persistence_failure"
	QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable QAErrorCategory = "runtime_unavailable"
	QAErrorAdmissionBlocked   QAErrorCategory = "admission_blocked"
	QAErrorAssertionFailure   QAErrorCategory = "assertion_failure"
	QAErrorCleanupUncertain   QAErrorCategory = "cleanup_uncertain"
	QAErrorMalformedEvidence  QAErrorCategory = "malformed_evidence"
)

type QAError struct {
	Category  QAErrorCategory `json:"category"`
	Operation string          `json:"operation"`
	Detail    string          `json:"detail"`
	Recovery  string          `json:"recovery"`
	Cause     error           `json:"-"`
}

func (e *QAError) Error() string {
	if e == nil {
		return ""
	}
	if e.Detail != "" {
		return fmt.Sprintf("qa %s: %s", e.Operation, e.Detail)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("qa %s: %s", e.Operation, e.Category)
}

func (e *QAError) Unwrap() error {
	if e == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return e.Cause
}

func NewQAError(category QAErrorCategory, operation, detail string, cause error) *QAError {
	return &QAError{Category: category, Operation: operation, Detail: detail, Recovery: qaRecovery(category), Cause: cause}
}

func AsQAError(err error) (*QAError, bool) {
	var target *QAError
	ok := errors.As(err, &target)
	return target, ok
}

func qaRecovery(category QAErrorCategory) string {
	switch category {
	case QAErrorUnknownSchema:
		return "Use a compatible UltraPlan binary or an explicit supported migration."
	case QAErrorInvalidState:
		return "Inspect the detailed state and run explicit QA recovery."
	case QAErrorStaleInput:
		return "Rebuild the QA map from current governed inputs."
	case QAErrorPermissionDenied:
		return "Use a runtime that enforces the required read-only permission policy."
	case QAErrorBudgetExhausted:
		return "Reduce the governed scope or lower work per attempt; do not raise product maxima."
	case QAErrorConflict:
		return "Wait for the current owner or cancel it through run control."
	case QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
		return "Restore reliable workspace persistence, then run explicit QA recovery."
	case QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable:
		return "Restore the configured runtime and resume the current semantic attempt."
	case QAErrorAdmissionBlocked:
		return "Restore the current review, containing smoke, mapping, and isolation prerequisites before retrying."
	case QAErrorAssertionFailure:
		return "Inspect the admitted evidence and adjudicated issue before any governed repair."
	case QAErrorCleanupUncertain:
		return "Inspect and remove the isolated workspace, then start a new QA attempt."
	case QAErrorMalformedEvidence:
		return "Discard the invalid attempt and rerun the evidence plan from current inputs."
	default:
		return "Inspect the QA status and next action."
	}
}

542: func newQAID(kind, project, sprint, parent string, content any) (string, error) {
543: 	if !safeQAName(project) || !safeQAName(sprint) || strings.TrimSpace(kind) == "" {
544: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid QA identity scope")
545: 	}
546: 	data, err := canonicalQAJSON(content)
547: 	if err != nil {
548: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize QA identity: %w", err)
549: 	}
550: 	digest := sha256.Sum256(bytes.Join([][]byte{[]byte(QAIDScope), []byte(kind), []byte(project), []byte(sprint), []byte(parent), data}, []byte{0}))
551: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s", QAIDScope, kind, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:12])), nil
552: }

554: func canonicalQAJSON(value any) ([]byte, error) {
555: 	var buf bytes.Buffer
556: 	encoder := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
557: 	encoder.SetEscapeHTML(false)
558: 	if err := encoder.Encode(value); err != nil {
559: 		return nil, err
560: 	}
561: 	return bytes.TrimSuffix(buf.Bytes(), []byte("\n")), nil
562: }

564: var qaIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^qa-v1-(attempt|map|shard|theory|challenge|synthesis)-[0-9a-f]{24}$`)

568: func safeQAName(value string) bool {
569: 	if value == "" || len(value) > 128 || strings.Contains(value, "..") {
570: 		return false
571: 	}
572: 	for _, r := range value {
573: 		if !(r == '-' || r == '_' || r == '.' || r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
574: 			return false
575: 		}
576: 	}
577: 	return true
578: }

585: 	return err == nil

608: func validateQABudgets(got QABudgets) error {
609: 	max := MaximumQABudgets()
610: 	ints := []struct {
611: 		name     string
612: 		got, max int
613: 	}{
614: 		{"changed_paths", got.ChangedPaths, max.ChangedPaths}, {"primary_shards", got.PrimaryShards, max.PrimaryShards}, {"boundary_shards", got.BoundaryShards, max.BoundaryShards},
615: 		{"follow_up_shards", got.FollowUpShards, max.FollowUpShards}, {"total_shards", got.TotalShards, max.TotalShards}, {"pending_entries", got.PendingEntries, max.PendingEntries},
616: 		{"changed_paths_per_shard", got.ChangedPathsPerShard, max.ChangedPathsPerShard}, {"context_paths_per_shard", got.ContextPathsPerShard, max.ContextPathsPerShard},
617: 		{"context_expansions", got.ContextExpansions, max.ContextExpansions}, {"paths_per_expansion", got.PathsPerExpansion, max.PathsPerExpansion},
618: 		{"behavioral_concerns_per_shard", got.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, max.BehavioralConcernsPerShard}, {"theories_per_shard", got.TheoriesPerShard, max.TheoriesPerShard},
619: 		{"iterations_per_attempt", got.IterationsPerAttempt, max.IterationsPerAttempt}, {"commands_per_attempt", got.CommandsPerAttempt, max.CommandsPerAttempt},
620: 		{"output_repair_attempts", got.OutputRepairAttempts, max.OutputRepairAttempts}, {"concurrent_investigators", got.ConcurrentInvestigators, max.ConcurrentInvestigators},
621: 		{"command_output_bytes", got.CommandOutputBytes, max.CommandOutputBytes}, {"shard_output_bytes", got.ShardOutputBytes, max.ShardOutputBytes},
622: 		{"prompt_bytes", got.PromptBytes, max.PromptBytes}, {"recent_progress", got.RecentProgress, max.RecentProgress},
623: 		{"retained_attempts", got.RetainedAttempts, max.RetainedAttempts}, {"state_bytes", got.StateBytes, max.StateBytes},
624: 		{"tree_files", got.TreeFiles, max.TreeFiles}, {"generated_checks", got.GeneratedChecks, max.GeneratedChecks},
625: 		{"generated_patch_bytes", got.GeneratedPatchBytes, max.GeneratedPatchBytes}, {"evidence_records", got.EvidenceRecords, max.EvidenceRecords},
626: 		{"issues", got.Issues, max.Issues}, {"analyzer_calls", got.AnalyzerCalls, max.AnalyzerCalls}, {"evaluator_calls", got.EvaluatorCalls, max.EvaluatorCalls},
627: 	}
628: 	for _, limit := range ints {
629: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
630: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
631: 		}
632: 	}
633: 	durations := []struct {
634: 		name     string
635: 		got, max time.Duration
636: 	}{{"command_timeout", got.CommandTimeout, max.CommandTimeout}, {"shard_timeout", got.ShardTimeout, max.ShardTimeout}, {"run_timeout", got.RunTimeout, max.RunTimeout}, {"cleanup_timeout", got.CleanupTimeout, max.CleanupTimeout}}
637: 	for _, limit := range durations {
638: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
639: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be positive and no greater than %s", limit.name, limit.max)
640: 		}
641: 	}
642: 	for _, limit := range []struct {
643: 		name     string
644: 		got, max int64
645: 	}{{"tree_bytes", got.TreeBytes, max.TreeBytes}, {"file_bytes", got.FileBytes, max.FileBytes}} {
646: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
647: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
648: 		}
649: 	}
650: 	if got.AnalyzerCalls != 3 || got.EvaluatorCalls != 3 {
651: 		return fmt.Errorf("qa semantic analyzer and evaluator counts must be exactly 3")
652: 	}
653: 	return nil
654: }

666: 	if len(theory.ExpectationRefs) == 0 || len(theory.AttemptHistory) == 0 {

678: func ValidateQAMap(m QAMap) error {
679: 	if m.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(m.ID) || !validQAID(m.SemanticAttemptID) || !safeQAName(m.Project) || !safeQAName(m.Sprint) {
680: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA map schema or identity")
681: 	}
682: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"governed input": m.GovernedInputFingerprint, "implementation": m.ImplementationFingerprint, "review": m.ReviewFingerprint, "policy": m.PolicyFingerprint, "check catalog": m.CheckCatalogFingerprint, "target": m.Target.Fingerprint} {
683: 		if !validFingerprint(value) {
684: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s fingerprint", name)
685: 		}
686: 	}
687: 	if err := validateQABudgets(m.Budgets); err != nil {
688: 		return err
689: 	}
690: 	owners := map[string]int{}
691: 	ownerIDs := map[string]string{}
692: 	for _, shard := range m.Shards {
693: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil {
694: 			return err
695: 		}
696: 		if shard.Kind == QAShardPrimary {
697: 			for _, path := range shard.ChangedPaths {
698: 				owners[path]++
699: 				ownerIDs[path] = shard.ID
700: 			}
701: 		}
702: 	}
703: 	for _, path := range m.Coverage.ChangedPaths {
704: 		if owners[path] != 1 || m.Coverage.PrimaryOwners[path] != ownerIDs[path] {
705: 			return fmt.Errorf("changed path %q must have exactly one primary owner", path)
706: 		}
707: 	}
708: 	return nil
709: }

711: func ValidateQAShard(shard QAShard) error {

715: 	switch shard.Kind {
716: 	case QAShardPrimary:

756: func ValidateQASynthesis(synthesis QASynthesis, budgets QABudgets) error {
757: 	if synthesis.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(synthesis.ID) || !validQAID(synthesis.AttemptID) || !validQAID(synthesis.MapID) {
758: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis schema or identity")
759: 	}
760: 	theoryIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(synthesis.TheoryIDs))
761: 	for _, theoryID := range synthesis.TheoryIDs {
762: 		if !validQAID(theoryID) {
763: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis theory reference")
764: 		}
765: 		theoryIDs[theoryID] = struct{}{}
766: 	}
767: 	if len(synthesis.FollowUpShards) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
768: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds follow-up shard budget")
769: 	}
770: 	if len(synthesis.Challenges) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
771: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds challenger record budget")
772: 	}
773: 	for _, challenge := range synthesis.Challenges {
774: 		if err := ValidateQAChallenge(challenge, budgets); err != nil || challenge.MapID != synthesis.MapID {
775: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis challenge")
776: 		}
777: 		for _, theoryID := range challenge.TheoryIDs {
778: 			if _, ok := theoryIDs[theoryID]; !ok {
779: 				return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis challenge references an unknown theory")
780: 			}
781: 		}
782: 	}
783: 	for _, shard := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
784: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil || shard.Kind != QAShardFollowUp {
785: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis follow-up shard")
786: 		}
787: 	}
788: 	if strings.TrimSpace(synthesis.NextAction) == "" {
789: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis next action is required")
790: 	}
791: 	return nil
792: }

797: 	}
798: 	if len(challenge.TheoryIDs) == 0 || len(challenge.TheoryIDs) > budgets.TheoriesPerShard {

808: 	}
809: 	return nil

542: func newQAID(kind, project, sprint, parent string, content any) (string, error) {
543: 	if !safeQAName(project) || !safeQAName(sprint) || strings.TrimSpace(kind) == "" {
544: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid QA identity scope")
545: 	}
546: 	data, err := canonicalQAJSON(content)
547: 	if err != nil {
548: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize QA identity: %w", err)
549: 	}
550: 	digest := sha256.Sum256(bytes.Join([][]byte{[]byte(QAIDScope), []byte(kind), []byte(project), []byte(sprint), []byte(parent), data}, []byte{0}))
551: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s", QAIDScope, kind, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:12])), nil
552: }

554: func canonicalQAJSON(value any) ([]byte, error) {
555: 	var buf bytes.Buffer
556: 	encoder := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
557: 	encoder.SetEscapeHTML(false)
558: 	if err := encoder.Encode(value); err != nil {
559: 		return nil, err
560: 	}
561: 	return bytes.TrimSuffix(buf.Bytes(), []byte("\n")), nil
562: }

568: func safeQAName(value string) bool {
569: 	if value == "" || len(value) > 128 || strings.Contains(value, "..") {
570: 		return false
571: 	}
572: 	for _, r := range value {
573: 		if !(r == '-' || r == '_' || r == '.' || r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
574: 			return false
575: 		}
576: 	}
577: 	return true
578: }

582: 		return false
583: 	}

585: 	return err == nil

608: func validateQABudgets(got QABudgets) error {
609: 	max := MaximumQABudgets()
610: 	ints := []struct {
611: 		name     string
612: 		got, max int
613: 	}{
614: 		{"changed_paths", got.ChangedPaths, max.ChangedPaths}, {"primary_shards", got.PrimaryShards, max.PrimaryShards}, {"boundary_shards", got.BoundaryShards, max.BoundaryShards},
615: 		{"follow_up_shards", got.FollowUpShards, max.FollowUpShards}, {"total_shards", got.TotalShards, max.TotalShards}, {"pending_entries", got.PendingEntries, max.PendingEntries},
616: 		{"changed_paths_per_shard", got.ChangedPathsPerShard, max.ChangedPathsPerShard}, {"context_paths_per_shard", got.ContextPathsPerShard, max.ContextPathsPerShard},
617: 		{"context_expansions", got.ContextExpansions, max.ContextExpansions}, {"paths_per_expansion", got.PathsPerExpansion, max.PathsPerExpansion},
618: 		{"behavioral_concerns_per_shard", got.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, max.BehavioralConcernsPerShard}, {"theories_per_shard", got.TheoriesPerShard, max.TheoriesPerShard},
619: 		{"iterations_per_attempt", got.IterationsPerAttempt, max.IterationsPerAttempt}, {"commands_per_attempt", got.CommandsPerAttempt, max.CommandsPerAttempt},
620: 		{"output_repair_attempts", got.OutputRepairAttempts, max.OutputRepairAttempts}, {"concurrent_investigators", got.ConcurrentInvestigators, max.ConcurrentInvestigators},
621: 		{"command_output_bytes", got.CommandOutputBytes, max.CommandOutputBytes}, {"shard_output_bytes", got.ShardOutputBytes, max.ShardOutputBytes},
622: 		{"prompt_bytes", got.PromptBytes, max.PromptBytes}, {"recent_progress", got.RecentProgress, max.RecentProgress},
623: 		{"retained_attempts", got.RetainedAttempts, max.RetainedAttempts}, {"state_bytes", got.StateBytes, max.StateBytes},
624: 		{"tree_files", got.TreeFiles, max.TreeFiles}, {"generated_checks", got.GeneratedChecks, max.GeneratedChecks},
625: 		{"generated_patch_bytes", got.GeneratedPatchBytes, max.GeneratedPatchBytes}, {"evidence_records", got.EvidenceRecords, max.EvidenceRecords},
626: 		{"issues", got.Issues, max.Issues}, {"analyzer_calls", got.AnalyzerCalls, max.AnalyzerCalls}, {"evaluator_calls", got.EvaluatorCalls, max.EvaluatorCalls},
627: 	}
628: 	for _, limit := range ints {
629: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
630: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
631: 		}
632: 	}
633: 	durations := []struct {
634: 		name     string
635: 		got, max time.Duration
636: 	}{{"command_timeout", got.CommandTimeout, max.CommandTimeout}, {"shard_timeout", got.ShardTimeout, max.ShardTimeout}, {"run_timeout", got.RunTimeout, max.RunTimeout}, {"cleanup_timeout", got.CleanupTimeout, max.CleanupTimeout}}
637: 	for _, limit := range durations {
638: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
639: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be positive and no greater than %s", limit.name, limit.max)
640: 		}
641: 	}
642: 	for _, limit := range []struct {
643: 		name     string
644: 		got, max int64
645: 	}{{"tree_bytes", got.TreeBytes, max.TreeBytes}, {"file_bytes", got.FileBytes, max.FileBytes}} {
646: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
647: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
648: 		}
649: 	}
650: 	if got.AnalyzerCalls != 3 || got.EvaluatorCalls != 3 {
651: 		return fmt.Errorf("qa semantic analyzer and evaluator counts must be exactly 3")
652: 	}
653: 	return nil
654: }

678: func ValidateQAMap(m QAMap) error {
679: 	if m.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(m.ID) || !validQAID(m.SemanticAttemptID) || !safeQAName(m.Project) || !safeQAName(m.Sprint) {
680: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA map schema or identity")

682: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"governed input": m.GovernedInputFingerprint, "implementation": m.ImplementationFingerprint, "review": m.ReviewFingerprint, "policy": m.PolicyFingerprint, "check catalog": m.CheckCatalogFingerprint, "target": m.Target.Fingerprint} {
683: 		if !validFingerprint(value) {
684: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s fingerprint", name)
685: 		}
686: 	}
687: 	if err := validateQABudgets(m.Budgets); err != nil {
688: 		return err
689: 	}
690: 	owners := map[string]int{}
691: 	ownerIDs := map[string]string{}
692: 	for _, shard := range m.Shards {
693: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil {
694: 			return err
695: 		}
696: 		if shard.Kind == QAShardPrimary {
697: 			for _, path := range shard.ChangedPaths {
698: 				owners[path]++
699: 				ownerIDs[path] = shard.ID
700: 			}
701: 		}
702: 	}
703: 	for _, path := range m.Coverage.ChangedPaths {
704: 		if owners[path] != 1 || m.Coverage.PrimaryOwners[path] != ownerIDs[path] {
705: 			return fmt.Errorf("changed path %q must have exactly one primary owner", path)
706: 		}
707: 	}
708: 	return nil
709: }

756: func ValidateQASynthesis(synthesis QASynthesis, budgets QABudgets) error {
757: 	if synthesis.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(synthesis.ID) || !validQAID(synthesis.AttemptID) || !validQAID(synthesis.MapID) {
758: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis schema or identity")
759: 	}
760: 	theoryIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(synthesis.TheoryIDs))
761: 	for _, theoryID := range synthesis.TheoryIDs {
762: 		if !validQAID(theoryID) {
763: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis theory reference")
764: 		}
765: 		theoryIDs[theoryID] = struct{}{}
766: 	}
767: 	if len(synthesis.FollowUpShards) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
768: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds follow-up shard budget")
769: 	}
770: 	if len(synthesis.Challenges) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
771: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds challenger record budget")
772: 	}
773: 	for _, challenge := range synthesis.Challenges {
774: 		if err := ValidateQAChallenge(challenge, budgets); err != nil || challenge.MapID != synthesis.MapID {
775: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis challenge")
776: 		}
777: 		for _, theoryID := range challenge.TheoryIDs {
778: 			if _, ok := theoryIDs[theoryID]; !ok {
779: 				return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis challenge references an unknown theory")
780: 			}
781: 		}
782: 	}
783: 	for _, shard := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
784: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil || shard.Kind != QAShardFollowUp {
785: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis follow-up shard")
786: 		}
787: 	}
788: 	if strings.TrimSpace(synthesis.NextAction) == "" {
789: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis next action is required")
790: 	}
791: 	return nil
792: }

900: func qaRecovery(category QAErrorCategory) string {
901: 	switch category {
902: 	case QAErrorUnknownSchema:
903: 		return "Use a compatible UltraPlan binary or an explicit supported migration."
904: 	case QAErrorInvalidState:
905: 		return "Inspect the detailed state and run explicit QA recovery."
906: 	case QAErrorStaleInput:
907: 		return "Rebuild the QA map from current governed inputs."
908: 	case QAErrorPermissionDenied:
909: 		return "Use a runtime that enforces the required read-only permission policy."
910: 	case QAErrorBudgetExhausted:
911: 		return "Reduce the governed scope or lower work per attempt; do not raise product maxima."
912: 	case QAErrorConflict:
913: 		return "Wait for the current owner or cancel it through run control."
914: 	case QAErrorPersistenceFailure:

442: func (s Service) buildQAEvidencePublication(ctx context.Context, sp Sprint, qaMap QAMap, target string, shards []QAShard, progress func(QAProgress)) (QAEvidencePublication, QAAssessmentRecord, error) {
443: 	status, err := s.VerificationStatus(sp.Project, sp.Slug)
444: 	if err != nil {
445: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorAdmissionBlocked, "admission", "verification prerequisites are unavailable", err)
446: 	}
447: 	capabilities := pprocess.IsolationCapabilityFacts()
448: 	admission := QAAdmission{
449: 		ReviewCurrent: status.Review.Fresh, ReviewVerdict: status.Review.Verdict,
450: 		SmokeCurrent: status.Smoke.Fresh, SmokeVerdict: status.Smoke.Verdict, ContainingSmoke: status.Smoke.Fresh,
451: 		ReadOnlyProofs: []string{"deterministic_map", "bounded_investigation", "synthesis"}, MapComplete: len(qaMap.Coverage.BlockedPaths) == 0 && len(qaMap.Coverage.PrimaryOwners) == len(qaMap.Coverage.ChangedPaths),
452: 		IsolationProven:     capabilities.NativeProtectedRootDeny && capabilities.DescendantCleanup && capabilities.WorkspaceRemoval,
453: 		WritableConcurrency: 1,
454: 	}
455: 	if err := ValidateQAAdmission(admission); err != nil {
456: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
457: 	}
458: 	limits := pprocess.IsolationLimits{MaxFiles: qaMap.Budgets.TreeFiles, MaxBytes: qaMap.Budgets.TreeBytes, MaxFileSize: qaMap.Budgets.FileBytes, Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.ShardTimeout}
459: 	targetIdentity, err := pprocess.IdentifyTree(ctx, target, limits)
460: 	if err != nil {
461: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "admission", "cannot freeze the protected target identity", err)
462: 	}
463: 	mapFingerprint, err := fingerprintQAValue(qaMap)
464: 	if err != nil {
465: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
466: 	}
467: 	workspaceParent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "ultraplan-qa-evidence-")
468: 	if err != nil {
469: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "admission", "cannot create the private QA workspace parent", err)
470: 	}
471: 	defer os.RemoveAll(workspaceParent)
472: 	plans := make([]QAEvidencePlan, 0, len(shards))
473: 	records := make([]QAEvidenceRecord, 0, len(shards))
474: 	candidates := make([]QAIssueCandidate, 0)
475: 	evaluators := make([]QAModelObservation, 0)
476: 	completedEvidence := 0
477: 	for _, shard := range shards {
478: 		if shard.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted {
479: 			continue
480: 		}
481: 		approvedPaths := normalizeQAStrings(append(append([]string(nil), shard.ChangedPaths...), shard.ContextPaths...))
482: 		if len(approvedPaths) == 0 {
483: 			continue
484: 		}
485: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_started", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Running isolated evidence check"})
486: 		descriptors, checkErr := ApprovedQAChecks(target, shard.ChangedPaths, qaMap.Budgets)
487: 		if checkErr != nil {
488: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, checkErr
489: 		}
490: 		descriptor := QACheckDescriptor{Executable: "true", Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.CommandTimeout, OutputLimit: qaMap.Budgets.CommandOutputBytes}
491: 		if len(descriptors) > 0 {
492: 			descriptor = descriptors[0]
493: 		}
494: 		executable, lookupErr := exec.LookPath(descriptor.Executable)
495: 		if lookupErr != nil {
496: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorAdmissionBlocked, "plan evidence", "an approved check executable is unavailable", lookupErr)
497: 		}
498: 		plan, planErr := FreezeQAEvidencePlan(sp.Project, sp.Slug, QAEvidencePlan{
499: 			AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ShardID: shard.ID, ExpectationRefs: shard.ExpectationRefs,
500: 			Kind: QACheckFact, ConfirmationCondition: "approved check exits successfully", RefutationCondition: "approved check exits unsuccessfully", InconclusiveCondition: "approved check is incomplete",
501: 			ApprovedPaths: approvedPaths, Executable: executable, Args: append([]string(nil), descriptor.Args...), Timeout: descriptor.Timeout, OutputLimit: descriptor.OutputLimit,
502: 			CleanupRequired: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint,
503: 		}, qaMap.Budgets, s.now().UTC())
504: 		if planErr != nil {
505: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, planErr
506: 		}
507: 		record, runErr := RunQAInvestigation(ctx, QAInvestigationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, TargetRoot: target, WorkspaceParent: workspaceParent, ProtectedRoots: []string{s.root, target}, Plan: plan, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, ExpectedTargetID: targetIdentity.Digest, Now: s.now})
508: 		if runErr != nil {
509: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, runErr
510: 		}
511: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
512: 			observations, finalOutcome, evaluationErr := s.evaluateFailedEvidence(ctx, sp, record, plan)
513: 			evaluators = append(evaluators, observations...)
514: 			if evaluationErr != nil {
515: 				record.Outcome, record.ReasonCode = QAEvidenceBlocked, "evaluator_incomplete"
516: 			} else {
517: 				record.Outcome = finalOutcome
518: 				record.Repeatable = finalOutcome == QAEvidenceFail
519: 				record.ReasonCode = "failed_shard_evaluated"
520: 			}
521: 		}
522: 		plans, records = append(plans, plan), append(records, record)
523: 		completedEvidence++
524: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_completed", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Isolated evidence check complete"})
525: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
526: 			title, claim, location := "Approved QA check failed", "an approved check failed in the isolated copy", approvedPaths[0]
527: 			if len(shard.Theories) > 0 {
528: 				title, claim, location = shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].VerificationSurface
529: 			}
530: 			candidates = append(candidates, QAIssueCandidate{Title: title, Claim: claim, IssueClass: "behavior", Severity: "medium", Location: location, EvidenceIDs: []string{record.ID}, RepairEligible: true, RegressionCandidate: true})
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 	adjudication, err := AdjudicateQA(QAAdjudicationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint, Plans: plans, Evidence: records, Candidates: candidates, Evaluators: evaluators, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, Now: s.now().UTC()})
534: 	if err != nil {
535: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
536: 	}
537: 	assessmentValue, nextAction := DeriveQAAssessment(status.Review, records, adjudication, &status.Smoke, nil)
538: 	assessmentID, err := NewQAV2ID("assessment", sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, struct {
539: 		Assessment OverallAssessment
540: 		Evidence   []string
541: 		Issues     int
542: 	}{assessmentValue, adjudication.AcceptedIDs, len(adjudication.Issues)})
543: 	if err != nil {
544: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
545: 	}
546: 	assessment := QAAssessmentRecord{SchemaVersion: QAEvidenceSchemaVersion, ID: assessmentID, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ReviewVerdict: ReviewVerdict(status.Review.Verdict), ReviewFingerprint: status.Review.InputFingerprint, SmokeVerdict: SmokeVerdict(status.Smoke.Verdict), SmokeRunID: status.Smoke.RunID, Assessment: assessmentValue, EvidenceTotal: len(records), RejectedTotal: len(adjudication.Rejected), IssueTotal: len(adjudication.Issues), NextAction: nextAction, CompletedAt: s.now().UTC()}
547: 	report, err := RenderQAReport(sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, records, adjudication, assessment)
548: 	if err != nil {
549: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
550: 	}
551: 	return QAEvidencePublication{Plans: plans, Records: records, Adjudication: &adjudication, Assessment: &assessment, Report: []byte(report), Budgets: qaMap.Budgets}, assessment, nil
552: }

577: func (s Service) prepareQAAttempt(store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, req QARunRequest, settings QASettings) (QAState, []QAShard, error) {
578: 	now := s.now().UTC()
579: 	if req.Resume {
580: 		prior, err := store.LoadState()
581: 		if err == nil && prior.CurrentAttemptID == qaMap.SemanticAttemptID && prior.Map != nil {
582: 			shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
583: 			for i := range shards {
584: 				loaded, loadErr := store.LoadShard(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, shards[i].ID)
585: 				if loadErr == nil && (loaded.Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || loaded.Phase == QAPhaseBlocked) {
586: 					shards[i] = loaded
587: 				}
588: 			}
589: 			prior.Run = qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed)
590: 			prior.Phase = QAPhaseQueued
591: 			prior.Blocker = nil
592: 			prior.Cancellation = QACancellation{}
593: 			prior.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
594: 			prior.TotalShards = len(shards)
595: 			prior.NextAction = "Resume incomplete shards from the current semantic attempt."
596: 			prior.UpdatedAt = now
597: 			if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: prior, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
598: 				return QAState{}, nil, err
599: 			}
600: 			return prior, shards, nil
601: 		}
602: 	}
603: 	state := QAState{SchemaVersion: QASchemaVersion, Project: qaMap.Project, Sprint: qaMap.Sprint, Phase: QAPhaseMapped,
604: 		Freshness:        QAFreshness{Current: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, ReviewFingerprint: qaMap.ReviewFingerprint, PolicyFingerprint: qaMap.PolicyFingerprint},
605: 		CurrentAttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, CompletedShards: countTerminalQAShards(qaMap.Shards), TotalShards: len(qaMap.Shards), Run: qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed), NextAction: "Run the mapped read-only QA shards.", UpdatedAt: now}
606: 	shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
607: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Map: &qaMap, Shards: shards, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
608: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
609: 	}
610: 	loaded, err := store.LoadState()
611: 	if err != nil {
612: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
613: 	}
614: 	if err := store.PruneAttempts(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, settings.Budgets.RetainedAttempts); err != nil {
615: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
616: 	}
617: 	return loaded, shards, nil
618: }

620: func (s Service) runQAShardBatch(ctx context.Context, store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, target string, shards []QAShard, state QAState, req QARunRequest) ([]QAShard, QAState, error) {
621: 	batchCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
622: 	defer cancel()
623: 	abortResults := make(chan struct{})
624: 	indices := make([]int, 0, len(shards))
625: 	for i := range shards {
626: 		if shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseBlocked {
627: 			continue
628: 		}
629: 		if req.FocusShard != "" && shards[i].ID != req.FocusShard {
630: 			continue
631: 		}
632: 		indices = append(indices, i)
633: 	}
634: 	if req.FocusShard != "" && len(indices) == 0 {
635: 		return shards, state, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "focused shard is absent or already terminal", nil)
636: 	}
637: 	workers := qaMap.Budgets.ConcurrentInvestigators
638: 	if workers > len(indices) {
639: 		workers = len(indices)
640: 	}
641: 	if workers == 0 {
642: 		return shards, state, nil
643: 	}
644: 	jobs := make(chan int, workers)
645: 	results := make(chan qaShardResult, workers)
646: 	var group sync.WaitGroup
647: 	for i := 0; i < workers; i++ {
648: 		group.Add(1)
649: 		go func() {
650: 			defer group.Done()
651: 			for index := range jobs {
652: 				shard, err := s.runOneQAShardSafely(batchCtx, qaMap, shards[index], target, req.WriterToken)
653: 				select {
654: 				case results <- qaShardResult{shard: shard, err: err}:
655: 				case <-abortResults:
656: 					return
657: 				}
658: 			}
659: 		}()
660: 	}
661: 	go func() {
662: 		defer close(jobs)
663: 		for _, index := range indices {
664: 			select {
665: 			case jobs <- index:
666: 			case <-batchCtx.Done():
667: 				return
668: 			}
669: 		}
670: 	}()
671: 	go func() {
672: 		group.Wait()
673: 		close(results)
674: 	}()
675: 	byID := make(map[string]int, len(shards))
676: 	for i := range shards {
677: 		byID[shards[i].ID] = i
678: 	}
679: 	var publishErr error
680: 	for result := range results {
681: 		if publishErr != nil {
682: 			continue
683: 		}
684: 		index := byID[result.shard.ID]
685: 		if result.err != nil {
686: 			switch {
687: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.Canceled):
688: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseCancelled
689: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
690: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseInterrupted
691: 			default:
692: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseBlocked
693: 			}
694: 			result.shard.Blocker = qaBlocker(result.err, result.shard.ID)
695: 		}
696: 		shards[index] = result.shard
697: 		state.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
698: 		state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
699: 		if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Shards: []QAShard{result.shard}, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
700: 			publishErr = err
701: 			close(abortResults)
702: 			cancel()
703: 			continue
704: 		}
705: 		emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: state.Phase, ShardID: result.shard.ID, ShardKind: result.shard.Kind, ShardPhase: result.shard.Phase, Event: "shard_terminal", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA shard reached a terminal state"})
706: 	}
707: 	if publishErr != nil {
708: 		return shards, state, publishErr
709: 	}
710: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
711: 		return shards, state, err
712: 	}
713: 	return shards, state, nil
714: }

716: func (s Service) runOneQAShardSafely(ctx context.Context, qaMap QAMap, shard QAShard, target string, token QAWriterToken) (result QAShard, err error) {
717: 	result = shard
718: 	defer func() {
719: 		if recovered := recover(); recovered != nil {
720: 			err = NewQAError(QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, "investigate shard", "investigator runtime panicked", fmt.Errorf("panic: %v", recovered))
721: 		}
722: 	}()
723: 	return s.runOneQAShard(ctx, qaMap, shard, target, token)
724: }

726: func (s Service) runOneQAShard(ctx context.Context, qaMap QAMap, shard QAShard, target string, token QAWriterToken) (QAShard, error) {
727: 	if err := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); err != nil {
728: 		return shard, err
729: 	}
730: 	request, err := s.QAInvestigatorRequest(qaMap, shard, target)
731: 	if err != nil {
732: 		return shard, err
733: 	}
734: 	request.Metadata["operation"] = "qa-investigate"
735: 	request.Metadata["task"] = shard.ID
736: 	request.Metadata["operational_attempt"] = token.OperationalAttemptID
737: 	capture := &qaOutputCapture{}
738: 	request.Validation = qaInvestigatorValidationSpec(qaMap.Budgets, capture)
739: 	previousOnEvent := request.OnEvent
740: 	request.OnEvent = func(event pruntime.Event) {
741: 		capture.observe(event.Payload)
742: 		if previousOnEvent != nil {
743: 			previousOnEvent(event)
744: 		}
745: 	}
746: 	before, identityErr := targetIdentity(target)
747: 	if identityErr != nil || before != qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint {
748: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "investigate shard", "implementation identity no longer matches the QA map", identityErr)
749: 	}
750: 	started := s.now().UTC()
751: 	result, runErr := s.runtime.StartRun(ctx, request)
752: 	if result.TerminalOutput == "" {
753: 		result.TerminalOutput = capture.load()
754: 	}
755: 	completed := s.now().UTC()
756: 	after, afterErr := targetIdentity(target)
757: 	attempt := QAInvestigatorAttempt{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/1", token.OperationalAttemptID, shard.ID), Number: 1, StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: &completed, ImplementationBefore: before, ImplementationAfter: after, Usage: qaUsageSummary(result.Usage)}
758: 	if result.Repair.Configured {
759: 		attempt.Repair = &QARepairDiagnostic{Attempted: result.Repair.Attempted, MaxAttempts: result.Repair.MaxAttempts, AttemptCount: result.Repair.AttemptCount, Exhausted: result.Repair.Exhausted, ExhaustedReason: result.Repair.ExhaustedReason, PermissionDenied: result.Repair.PermissionDenied, UnsupportedSameSession: result.Repair.UnsupportedSameSession}
760: 	}
761: 	if result.EstimatedCost != nil {
762: 		attempt.EstimatedCost = &QACostSummary{Amount: result.EstimatedCost.Amount, Currency: result.EstimatedCost.Currency, Estimate: result.EstimatedCost.Estimate}
763: 	}
764: 	if afterErr != nil || after != before {
765: 		attempt.StopReason = "implementation identity drift"
766: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
767: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "implementation identity changed during read-only investigation", afterErr)
768: 	}
769: 	if currentErr := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); currentErr != nil {
770: 		attempt.StopReason = "governed input drift"
771: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
772: 		return shard, currentErr
773: 	}
774: 	if result.Permissions.Mode != "restricted" || result.Permissions.Default != "deny" || result.Permissions.UnsupportedCount != 0 {
775: 		attempt.StopReason = "permission enforcement unavailable"
776: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
777: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "runtime did not enforce restricted default-deny permissions", nil)
778: 	}
779: 	if result.Validation.Configured && !result.Validation.Passed {
780: 		_, diagnostic, decodeErr := decodeQAInvestigatorOutput(result, qaMap.Budgets.ShardOutputBytes)
781: 		attempt.FailureKind, attempt.StopReason, attempt.OutputDiagnostic = "invalid_output", "investigator output repair exhausted", &diagnostic
782: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
783: 		detail := fmt.Sprintf("investigator output repair exhausted after %d repair attempts", result.Repair.AttemptCount)
784: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", detail, decodeErr)
785: 	}
786: 	if runErr != nil {
787: 		attempt.FailureKind, attempt.Retryable = classifyQARuntimeFailure(result, runErr)
788: 		attempt.StopReason = "runtime policy exhausted"
789: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
790: 		if errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
791: 			return shard, runErr
792: 		}
793: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, "investigate shard", "runtime resilience policy exhausted", runErr)
794: 	}
795: 	if result.Usage.TurnsKnown && result.Usage.Turns > int64(qaMap.Budgets.IterationsPerAttempt) {
796: 		attempt.StopReason = "investigator iteration limit exceeded"
797: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
798: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", fmt.Sprintf("investigator used %d turns; limit is %d", result.Usage.Turns, qaMap.Budgets.IterationsPerAttempt), nil)
799: 	}
800: 	output, diagnostic, decodeErr := decodeQAInvestigatorOutput(result, qaMap.Budgets.ShardOutputBytes)
801: 	if decodeErr != nil {
802: 		// Alternate runtimes may ignore ValidationSpec. Fail closed without
803: 		// adding a second product-owned retry loop.
804: 		attempt.FailureKind, attempt.StopReason, attempt.OutputDiagnostic = "invalid_output", "investigator output rejected", &diagnostic
805: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
806: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "investigate shard", "runtime returned invalid investigator output without validation repair metadata", decodeErr)
807: 	}
808: 	attempt.StopReason = "terminal investigator output accepted"
809: 	if len(output.Theories) > qaMap.Budgets.TheoriesPerShard || len(output.Context) > qaMap.Budgets.ContextExpansions || len(output.Checks) > qaMap.Budgets.CommandsPerAttempt {
810: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", "investigator output exceeds map-owned limits", nil)
811: 	}
812: 	attempt.ContextRequests = append([]QAContextRequest(nil), output.Context...)
813: 	attempt.Evidence = append([]QAEvidenceSummary(nil), output.Evidence...)
814: 	for _, contextRequest := range attempt.ContextRequests {
815: 		if contextRequest.Approved {
816: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "runtime cannot self-approve context expansion", nil)
817: 		}
818: 		if len(contextRequest.Paths) > qaMap.Budgets.PathsPerExpansion {
819: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", "context request exceeds path limit", nil)
820: 		}
821: 		for _, path := range contextRequest.Paths {
822: 			if err := validateQAPath(path); err != nil {
823: 				return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", err.Error(), err)
824: 			}
825: 		}
826: 	}
827: 	checks, err := ApprovedQAChecks(target, qaMap.Coverage.ChangedPaths, qaMap.Budgets)
828: 	if err != nil {
